A02-D09 | Festival proposal

Proposal extract. Omissions are marked […].

[Source page 1]

                     Together Festival - WHY

Together Festival is a new festival in Hørsholm, taking shape for the first time in
September 2022. The starting point for Together Festival is a political desire to
bring innovation and progressive thinking to Hørsholm.

We have persuaded Hørsholm Municipality that the right thing to do here in 2022 is to
move a bit away from a traditional concept of innovation and instead focus all
energy on solving social challenges.

When in our preliminary studies among young people from the area we have asked them what
is important to focus on, they say that we should focus on creating better
communities, more diversity and less social division. They experience it as a
problem that they are socially divided into groups, and that it is far too difficult to
move between these groups.

We believe that these young people, with their focus on diverse communities, address
a much broader challenge, a challenge with wide implications for
Hørsholm in general (as well as for similar provincial/rural areas).

These provincial areas are "successful" in the classical sense. There are rising
housing prices and a social environment largely defined by urban centers with
shopping opportunities. As online shopping takes larger
market shares, however, these areas must redefine themselves -
redefine local communities.

Therefore, it is extremely important right now that provincial areas manage to see the young people's
rebellion and demands for social changes, more inclusive communities, diversity
and equality as a great opportunity - something to be embraced rather than
something to be observed from a safe distance.

With Together Festival, this is precisely our goal.

We have a website under development here (it is work in progress):
http://togetherfestival.dk

                               1

[Source page 2]

                    Together Festival - What

Together Festival will consist of three tracks, where each track relates to the overall challenge from one specific professional perspective.


Each track will be built around a challenge from a business partner
(or group of partners). The challenge will be "answered" by one or more
young creators / artists / programmers etc. through an exploratory process.
Participants must develop
an answer to the challenge through local social experiments and explorations, which can be presented and exhibited at Together Festival.

                          Track: The City of the Future
In this track we will explore alternative perspectives on social dynamics in an
urban area. We will work with sound as an investigative tool - and the result
will be presented as a series of interactive domes with built-in sound journeys.


                        Track: Lifestyle and fashion
In this track we collaborate with an established fashion brand to create a
challenge for a young designer. The challenge will focus on how fashion
can bring people together instead of defining differences. The exhibition at
Together Festival will be a limited edition clothing series - and a functioning concept
store at the festival.

                          Track: AI and technology
In this track we will focus on the situation we currently find ourselves in regarding AI and
smart technologies. We thought social media would be the way to global
freedom of speech, but we increasingly see that they also mean increased surveillance,
restrictions on what we can say and express, and an extreme degree of
globalization and thereby homogenization of values, culture, and norms.

In this track, we will revive Struensee as an AI persona - and let him, who
is almost synonymous with the Age of Enlightenment, freedom of press and the abolition of
censorship, relate to the reality we currently face. What would Struensee,
as the reformer he was, think about today's challenges?

                        Collaboration

[…]

[Source page 3]

We believe that the idea of reviving Struensee is a strong idea that could
create awareness about AI and ethics in a playful and engaging way.

[…]

Therefore, we are very interested in exploring the possibilities of a
collaboration with you.

We have concrete funding secured for the core of Together Festival, but we would
very much like to expand the festival so that each of the tracks gains more weight and quality.

We are at the point where we will in any case carry out Together
Festival, and where we create a version of Struensee AI as a trademark for
the festival and as a starting point for talks and debates at the festival.

In this scenario, we would in any case be interested in
collaborating with you – both with respect to the development of Struensee AI, but also gladly regarding
debates and events focusing on AI / Ethics.

[…]

[…] We would really like to add a
teaching component as well, where final year primary or high school students could visit
Together Festival (in the period leading up to the actual festival) and be inspired
by Struensee AI.

[…]

This will, however, require that we succeed in finding additional funding over the next couple of
months. I do hope to involve you in this already, as I believe a
collaboration agreement with you will be a strong card in achieving funding.

[…] we have quite free hands to define a collaboration so that
it provides value for you. It is obvious to think in terms of formats that can be used in several
contexts, just as we see it as a big plus if you want to be
exposed and involved in Together Festival (both the conference and
culture festival parts).
